environment.description: Spring Boot service deployed on ECS Fargate in us-east-1. Task role arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/token-service-prod has full access to Secrets Manager (secretsmanager:*) and KMS (kms:*). Service is exposed via NLB on port 8080 with no additional authentication layer. Environment variables DB_PASSWORD and API_KEY are injected from Secrets Manager at task startup.
